rationale: The plan correctly refuses to refit a count model, ranks the full untruncated results table by the DESeq2 Wald statistic with explicit NA-drop, duplicate, and tie rules, and runs gseapy prerank against a named local MSigDB Hallmark 2026.1 GMT with the 15-500 window, 1000 permutations, seed 42, and BH FDR, reporting NES, FDR, and leading edge per set. The count-model criteria (QC, filter, normalization, formula) are not directly applicable since DE is upstream; the plan states this explicitly, gives the contrast direction and sign convention, and flags that the shallow sample_01 caveat is inherited and cannot be reassessed, which is the honest handling, though a minimal sanity check of the results table (e.g., stat distribution, p-value histogram) would have strengthened the QC posture. The report section is thorough with versions, universe size, thresholds, and the single-method caveat.
